candidate_workaround: Resolve diagnostic input paths from the runner implementation and verify existence before reading.
failure_signature: A diagnostic read named a nonexistent audit subdirectory despite the runner already declaring its provenance inputs.
recurrence_guard: Diagnostics select repository-relative inputs from the current runner source and require path existence before content reads.
rollback: Give the missing-path read zero evidence credit and make no repository mutation based on the failed lookup.
scope_boundary: Same-owner read-only path-resolution recovery only; no source ownership, authority, production, or independent-reproduction credit.
title: Resolve runner diagnostic paths from current source
trigger_preconditions: a diagnostic follows a runner failure
the runner source declares its actual inputs
